reviewFocus.en: Confirm current availability, quotas, permission scope and billing before enabling workflows. Cost investigation and ticket creation should not be generalized into permission to modify production resources autonomously.
reviewFocus.ko: 현재 제공 여부·할당량·권한 범위·과금을 확인한 후 작업 흐름을 활성화할 것을 제안합니다. 비용 조사·티켓 생성 기능을 운영 자원을 자율 변경할 권한으로 일반화하면 안 됩니다.

en.title: AWS FinOps Agent preview: investigation scope and regional limits

claims.text: AWS announced a FinOps Agent preview that answers cost questions, surfaces optimization recommendations, investigates cost anomalies and schedules recurring workflows. It can route findings through Jira or Slack; those capabilities do not establish measured savings.

evidence.quote: answers cost questions, surfaces optimization opportunities, automatically investigates cost anomalies, and runs recurring FinOps workflows on a schedule you define.
can open Jira tickets on your behalf.

claims.text: The announcement locates the preview in US East (N. Virginia), with cost data covering AWS Regions except GovCloud and China. It offers the service at no additional charge during preview; that is not a permanent price or an unlimited-use commitment.

evidence.quote: AWS FinOps Agent (preview) is available in the US East (N. Virginia) Region
except AWS GovCloud (US) Regions and AWS China (Beijing and Ningxia) Regions.
AWS FinOps Agent is offered at no additional charge during the preview.

ko.title: AWS FinOps Agent 미리보기의 조사 기능과 리전 범위

claims.text: AWS는 비용 질의·최적화 권고·비용 이상 조사·반복 작업 일정을 지원하는 FinOps Agent 미리보기를 발표했다. Jira·Slack으로 결과를 전달할 수 있지만 해당 기능이 실측 비용 절감을 입증하지는 않는다.

evidence.quote: answers cost questions, surfaces optimization opportunities, automatically investigates cost anomalies, and runs recurring FinOps workflows on a schedule you define.
can open Jira tickets on your behalf.

claims.text: 공지는 미리보기를 US East (N. Virginia)에서 제공하며 비용 데이터 범위에서 AWS GovCloud·China 리전을 제외한다고 설명한다. 미리보기 중 추가 요금이 없다는 안내이며 영구 가격이나 무제한 사용 약속은 아니다.

evidence.quote: AWS FinOps Agent (preview) is available in the US East (N. Virginia) Region
except AWS GovCloud (US) Regions and AWS China (Beijing and Ningxia) Regions.
AWS FinOps Agent is offered at no additional charge during the preview.
